name: starter-p2-es-regional-reefer
about: Starter P2 "The number" on the opening-es-regional-reefer brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

recipe.name: The number
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with the pay figure alone, exactly as the brief states it and with its unit (per mile, per week, per year). If the brief states no pay, lead with its strongest other figure (a bonus, home days, miles) — never a figure the brief does not hold. Who the job is for (the licence, the kind of run) goes in a few words on the small line above it, never in the pay line.
recipe.image_prompt_template: A plain {surface} background, {texture}, {light}, a soft {tone} gradient, nothing in the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc runs reefer freight from Chicago to Texas. No-touch freight, home weekly, and weekly pay. We need drivers 23+ with 2 years of experience. Dispatch speaks Spanish.
en.headline: No-touch reefer, home weekly

es.primary_text: Silvicom Inc mueve carga refrigerada de Chicago a Texas. Carga sin tocar, pago semanal y regreso a casa cada semana. Se requieren 2 años de experiencia y mayores de 23 años. El despacho habla español.
es.headline: Carga sin tocar, casa semanal

en.primary_text: Home every week. That is the run at Silvicom Inc — reefer freight on regional lanes, Chicago to Texas, no-touch all the way. Weekly pay, $0.64 to $0.72 per mile. Must be 23+ with 2 years behind the wheel. Dispatch speaks Spanish.
en.headline: Home weekly, reefer lanes

es.primary_text: Casa cada semana. Eso es lo que ofrece Silvicom Inc: carga refrigerada en rutas regionales de Chicago a Texas, sin tocar la carga. Pago semanal, de $0.64 a $0.72 por milla. Se requiere mayores de 23 años y 2 años de experiencia. El despacho habla español.

en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc runs reefer on a tight regional loop — Chicago down to Texas and back. No-touch freight keeps it clean. You are home weekly, paid weekly. Rate up to $0.72 per mile. Need 2 years of experience and must be 23+. Dispatch speaks Spanish.
en.headline: Regional reefer, weekly pay

es.primary_text: Silvicom Inc opera rutas regionales de refrigerado entre Chicago y Texas. Carga sin tocar, pago semanal y regreso a casa cada semana. Hasta $0.72 por milla. Se necesitan 2 años de experiencia y ser mayor de 23 años. El despacho habla español.
es.headline: Reefer regional, pago semanal
